api_analysis.hypothesis: The project already has softmax kernel in custom_ops.cu and binding infrastructure in place; the missing piece is the C++ binding file that registers conv_transpose1d_ext (cuDNN) and softmax_dim1_ext operators.
evidence: custom_ops.cu contains softmax_dim1_launcher but no conv launcher; the conv launcher is expected to be declared and linked from a .cpp file.
The task requires conv/convtranspose to be implemented with cuDNN in kernels/*.cpp.
changes: Create kernels/custom_ops_binding.cpp with full tensor checks, cuDNN implementation for conv_transpose1d_ext, and call to softmax_dim1_launcher for softmax_dim1_ext.

Ensure proper dtype/device checks and contiguous memory handling.
Register both operators in the module with exact names and argument order.
